Europe heatwave linked to over 1,300 excess deaths, WHO reports

A severe heatwave across Europe has been linked to more than 1,300 excess deaths, according to the World Health Organization. France has been particularly affected, with reports of over 1,000 deaths. The extreme temperatures have led to concerns about climate change and prompted safety measures for public events.
